I wrote the settings page to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run or render it, so it is untested.

- **Layout:** The page has the "Workspace settings" heading and three switchable sections, with General showing first.
- **General:** It has the "Workspace name" field prefilled with "Orbit Lab" and the three-way role choice with Editor selected. "Save changes" shows "Settings saved."
- **Notifications:** "Weekly summary email" starts on and "Mentions" starts off.
- **Danger zone:** It has a one-sentence permanence warning and a "Delete workspace" button.
- **Delete confirmation:** The button opens the "Delete Orbit Lab?" modal. "Cancel" closes it. The modal's "Delete workspace" closes it and shows "Workspace deleted." on the page.
- **Brand handling:** The page uses only the brand-mapped Tailwi
